_comment: Pattern 5 mutation run over vsock-native's JS BOUNDARY wrapper (lib/index.js) — the enclave<->host AF_VSOCK transport surface. The native addon (src/vsock_addon.cc) is Linux-only and not compiled on macOS/CI, so it is OUT of scope and only the JS wrapper is mutated. Targets: the accept-error classifier (fatal halt vs immediate retry vs delayed-retry — a misclassification can leave the enclave deaf after a transient accept() error, the exact H2 incident this code fixed), the addon-load diagnostics (L1: surface the root cause), and the VsockSocket stream lifecycle (L2: surface EBADF while open, clear the timeout timer on destroy). Tests stub the native addon via `_setAddonForTests`, so the suite is fully hermetic — no real AF_VSOCK fd is opened. Non-blocking (thresholds.break=null). See docs/quality/mutation-testing.md and docs/quality/mutation-triage/packages-video-vsock-native.md.
